title: When the van temperature record has a gap
titleZh: 貨車溫度紀錄中斷時的處理方式
passage:
DISPATCH DESK | Training card

The cab screen and the cargo logger serve different purposes. The cab screen shows the current air temperature near the driver. The logger records temperature inside the cargo area every five minutes. At the end of a trip, use the logger, not the cab screen, to complete the delivery record.

A gap in the logger file does not by itself mean that the cargo got warmer. First compare the file with the stop times on the route sheet. If an entire stop is missing, use the independent logger carried with the load, provided its clock was checked before departure. Record which logger supplied the missing portion. A cab-screen reading cannot fill a gap.

On Monday, the main file showed readings before and after a stop at the clinic, but none during the stop. The spare logger stayed with the cartons and recorded the entire trip. Its clock had not been checked. The driver also wrote down the reading shown on the cab screen while at the clinic. In such cases, flag the missing interval and send the record to the supervisor rather than estimating a temperature.
passageZh:
調度櫃台｜訓練卡

駕駛室螢幕和貨艙記錄器的用途不同。駕駛室螢幕顯示駕駛附近當下的氣溫。記錄器每五分鐘記錄一次貨艙內的溫度。行程結束時，請用記錄器完成送貨紀錄，不要採用駕駛室螢幕的讀數。

記錄器檔案有一段空白，本身不表示貨物變暖了。請先比對檔案和路線表上的停靠時間。若某站從頭到尾都缺讀數，請改採隨貨載運的獨立記錄器，但前提是出車前曾核對它的時鐘。請記下補上缺漏段落的是哪部記錄器。駕駛室螢幕的讀數不能用來填補缺漏。

星期一，主要記錄器有診所停靠前後的讀數，但沒有停靠期間的讀數。備用記錄器跟紙箱放在一起，也記錄了整段行程，但它的時鐘未核對。駕駛也抄下了在診所時駕駛室螢幕顯示的讀數。遇到這種情況，不要估算溫度；請標記缺漏時段，再把紀錄交給主管。
